hypotheses_validated.claim: Verifier finding 1 (major) reproduced and fixed: test_q4_conversion_close_to_f32[deepseek_v3] failed with a DLL built from the current quant*.c, because Q4 noise flips near-tied routing decisions and one flip moves a token's logits by up to 1.07x its own max|logit|. The test now bounds Q4-vs-F32 error with the Q4 model replaying the F32 routing (new Reference.replay_routes), and only loosely bounds free-routing agreement.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: Before the fix, with a fresh DLL (12:12, from quant.c 10:44 / quant_avx2.c and quant_avx512.c 10:24): 1 failed, 99 passed (assert 0.3203 < 0.15*1.9977). Sweep over 6 archs x seeds 1..8, Q4 experts + Q8 dense: free routing gives rel RMSE 0.073..0.337, corr >= 0.9425, decision agreement 0.79..1.0. Replayed routing gives rel RMSE 0.073..0.141, corr >= 0.9899, per-token max error / max|logit| <= 0.244. Test bounds: rel < 0.2, corr > 0.98, per-token <= 0.35, agreement >= 0.6. Parametrized over (qwen3_moe,1), (deepseek_v3,1), (deepseek_v3,3; failed the old bound), (qwen2_moe,5; agreement 0.81).

hypotheses_validated.claim: Verifier finding 2 (major) fixed: ContainerReader rejects metadata whose FORMAT.md 3.1 key has the wrong type, and applies the C reader's config rules (ranges, head divisibility, MLA, rope_dim, MoE/group consistency, dense_ffn_dim, bos/eos < vocab, tokenizer length/NUL). The only errors raised are ValueError (TypeError is converted too). The writer refuses the same metadata before writing.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: Differential run against engine/src/modelfile.c, using a scratch harness around hx_modelfile_open (scratchpad mfcheck.c, not in the repo): 1255 forged containers, made from the 58 BAD_META unit cases plus 1200 random single- or double-key metadata mutations of make_tiny models for all 5 archs (wrong types, boundary u32 values, NaN/inf/negative f32, bad layer_kind/eos arrays, long or NUL tokenizer strings). Agreement 1255/1255: 394 accepted by both, 861 rejected by both. Reference on the 394 accepted files: 333 evaluate, 42 ValueError, 19 KeyError (missing tensor), 0 other exceptions. Unit tests: test_metadata_types_and_ranges_are_validated (58 cases with message matching), test_metadata_validation_accepts_valid_variants, test_reference_rejects_bad_config (forged files incl. n_kv_heads 0 and 3).

hypotheses_validated.claim: Verifier minor findings fixed: n_layers is bounded (<= 512, as HX_MAX_LAYERS) before any per-layer list exists; act_quant_q8 ignores NaN in the block absmax like C; f16 decode quiets signalling NaNs (vcvtph2ps / q_f16); make_tiny works for any max_seq >= 1 and deletes the container when its checks fail; _native.matmul returns None only for rc == -2 and raises RuntimeError for every other failure.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_huge_layer_count_is_rejected_cheaply: n_layers 1e8 and 0xFFFFFFFF are rejected with < 4 MiB peak traced memory and in < 1 s. test_f16_decode_all_patterns: all 65536 f16 patterns match the definition and native hearth_dequantize bit for bit, for F16 and also as Q8/Q4 block scales (includes 0*inf and 0*NaN). test_matvec_bit_identical_to_engine_kernels now covers NaN, all-NaN-block and +-inf activations and NaN weights on scalar/AVX2/AVX-512; reference matvec stores NaN outputs as the kernels' canonical 0x7FC00000. test_make_tiny_short_max_seq (5 archs, max_seq 1 and 8; max_seq 0 raises and leaves no file). test_native_bindings_validate checks rc -2/-1/-3.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Each new or strengthened test catches the defect it targets.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: Scratch revert check: each of 12 fixes was reverted in a copy of python/ + tests/ and the relevant tests were run. All 12 were caught: act-quant NaN, f16 sNaN, canonical NaN, matmul rc, meta type check, n_layers bound, n_kv_heads range, dense-layer slab, max_seq tokens, make_tiny cleanup, out-of-vocab special ids, replay ignored.

hypotheses_validated.claim: The stricter reader breaks no other engineer's code or test.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: python -m pytest tests/py (all engineers' tests, HEARTH_LIB = kernels-only DLL): 512 passed, 5 skipped. The golden fixture builds all 11 golden make_tiny models, incl. big_q4 deepseek_v3 Q4 4x32 top-4, and they pass the new validation. Golden kernel tests: 5 passed.

hypotheses_falsified.claim: A whole-logit-matrix RMSE bound (0.15) is a sound check of Q4 conversion quality on tiny random MoE models.
hypotheses_falsified.evidence: With free routing it holds only by seed luck: deepseek_v3 seeds 2..8 give 0.214..0.337. Routing flips are legitimate quantization effects, not errors. Superseded by replayed-routing bounds.

open_questions: Intentional remaining differences from the C reader: C also requires rope_inv_freq to be present when rope_dim > 0 (Python checks its dtype/shape only when present, so generic format-test containers stay readable; Reference then raises KeyError if it is absent), and C rejects overlapping regions and alias groups without exactly one unflagged entry. Python does not check either, which is harmless for a reader that does bounded positional reads.
